observations.observed: Owner-supplied photograph of Korean 잠만보 HP150, 식탐, 철퍼덕프레스 130, Illus. HYOGONOSUKE, printed G sv2a 143/165 U. Master Ball silhouettes repeat across the card body (Master Ball mirror holo). The collector line is legible: the rarity mark after 143/165 is U. A Korean sv2a 181/165 AR Snorlax lies beside it in the same frame; it is a different release and is not part of this record. The collection owner identifies the card as the Korean sv2a Master Ball reverse holo (2026-10-30).

physicalObservation.basis: The photograph shows repeated ball silhouettes across the Korean sv2a 143/165 card body and the printed rarity mark U; the collection owner identifies the pattern as Master Ball (2026-10-30).
